mapper.select: SELECT o.*,s.school_id,s.name AS sale_name,s.seller FROM trade_orders o JOIN sales s ON o.selno=s.selno ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC
SELECT o.*,s.school_id,s.name AS sale_name,s.seller FROM trade_orders o JOIN sales s ON o.selno=s.selno WHERE order_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM trade_orders WHERE order_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_orders SET status='CANCELED' WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE trade_orders SET status='COMPLETED' WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status IN ('RESERVED','PAID')
UPDATE trade_orders SET meeting_place=#{meetingPlace},meeting_time=#{meetingTime},latitude=#{latitude},longitude=#{longitude} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE trade_orders SET status='PAYMENT_READY' WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE trade_orders SET status='PAID',payment_key=#{key} WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='PAYMENT_READY'
